name: JM Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: JM Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the supermarket business in Japan. The company is involved in the restaurant, event-related, and outsourcing businesses, as well as wholesale and retail of meat. In addition, it engages in the facility operation and management, and rice retail businesses. JM Holdings Co.,Ltd. was formerly known as Japan Meat Co.,Ltd. The company was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Tsuchiura, Japan.
